correctness.rationale: Exactly derive alternating transfer matrices from third-degree interpolation; their two-step trace and determinant have explicit rational closed forms. The three exact Schur expressions at scaling five factor into strictly positive polynomials for every r>0, so both multipliers are strictly smaller than 1/5 in modulus. Singular-ratio limits give -1/5 and zero, making the bound sharp. With fixed r the increments are summable. The packaged verifier checks the nonstandard symbolic identities by a second formula and sample characteristic roots; limits and boundaries are explicitly stated.

value.rationale: A natural alternation of long and short steps has an exact unrestricted positive-ratio parasitic spectral margin even though the standard general-grid BDF3 theorem requires ratios below about 2.553. The sharp period-two bound 1/5 gives an informative, reproducible structural stability result and separates long-run damping from potentially large within-period transients. It is neither a routine strengthening by rounding a constant nor an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
